prompt:
Hey, I need you to go through the five raw conversation log files in `logs/raw/` and update Enzo's personal intelligence files accordingly.

Enzo is a Global AI Lead at MediaPlus Group and we track what he shares and why in order to build a better picture of his interests and goals over time.

Specifically:
1. Process all five interaction logs and update his pattern tracking file (which should live at `notes/patterns.md`).
2. Look for any recurring themes across the logs — if something comes up often enough to be considered a confirmed pattern, make sure it's properly flagged.
3. Make sure his main user profile (`USER.md`) reflects any confirmed patterns that emerged.

The raw logs span from June 1st to June 9th, 2024. Some of the content is messy and conversational — use your judgment to categorize what he shared and what his intent was each time.
